excluded: reviews/*/packet.md — free prose composed for a human reviewer; no replay assertion reads it
profile.json — the owner's own persona and chrome; a replay needs neither, and an asker-tag duty is decided from the ask's own userId
thread-files/* — attachments, deliberately unredacted where they live and never committable
incident: The owner replied 'thanks for nothing' to a turn the bot had already answered, quoting the answer's own 'monitors are not deployed / these charts are a replay' caveat back at it. The router read that dismissal as a fresh ask and dispatched a full fresh-visible-session worker to answer it. A supervisor stop caught the worker mid-investigation, before it composed or posted anything. Open question the fixture is for: whether an owner's sarcastic dismissal of an existing answer should route to respond at all, and if so whether it should ever be a fresh-session answer rather than a recorded question back to the owner.
